title: Tests mirror owners: tests/Modules and the Scopes filter contract suite
summary: Moves module tests to `tests/Modules/{Scopes,Audit,DevTools}` per knowledge/target-structure#tests (scope behavior, Audit plugin/prune/participant/migration tests, generators and install), keeps the algebra part of scope properties in core with a no-declaration variant, adds `AzGuard\Scopes\Testing\AssignmentScopeFilterContractTests` (Spi(Call)) with a test using it on the module's own filter fixtures, and enforces that a module's tests import no other module.
why: target-structure rule 7 and #tests: module tests travel with their module (relocation rehearsal in P4); the contract suite is the module's supported tool for third-party filters (oracle row new/P3). Hard risk: moving tests must not drop any test — the item records the test count before and after.

include: Moves per the #tests table: `tests/Feature/Scopes` (behavior part), `tests/Fixtures/Scopes`, behavior part of `Authorization/Properties/ScopePropertiesTest` → `tests/Modules/Scopes/`; `tests/Feature/Plugins/Audit`, `tests/Contracts/Plugins/AuditPluginContractTest.php`, `tests/Feature/Console/AuditPruneCommandTest.php`, P3.5/P3.6 Audit tests → `tests/Modules/Audit/`; `tests/Feature/Console/Generators`, `tests/Feature/Console/InstallCommandTest.php` → `tests/Modules/DevTools/`

`packages/core/modules/scopes/src/Testing/AssignmentScopeFilterContractTests.php` (trait, #[Spi(kind: SpiKind::Call, since: '1.0')]) modeled on `Testing\Contracts\*ContractTests`: a filter only narrows (where-only), is pure for one runtime, refuses nothing core guards; used by `tests/Modules/Scopes/Contracts/FilterContractTest.php` for the fixture filters
`tests/zones.json` zones for the three modules (src = module root, tests = tests/Modules/<m>), `phpunit.xml` testsuite `Modules`, `tests/Pest.php` uses; `tests/README.md` ownership table

Arch rule (in `tests/Arch/OwnershipScanTest.php` or a new `tests/Arch/TestOwnershipTest.php`): files under `tests/Modules/<m>` reference no other module's namespace; files outside `tests/Modules` reference no module except the activation/parity fixtures listed in the rule
A test that imports two modules is split (record which)

reads.why: Rules every P3 item follows (reference + amendments win, no shims, placement, oracle, allowlists, snapshots, migration lines, tests)
Exact validation commands, PHP 8.4, driver ports, composer update rule
